news.title: New Website Launched
news.description: We are pleased to present our new reusable website structure. This platform makes it easy to add new content.

news.title: Modular Design Implemented
news.description: Our website now uses a fully modular design. Components can be easily reused and customized.

news.title: JSON-based Content Management
news.description: New content can be easily added by editing the JSON file without changing the HTML code.

news.title: Responsive Design
news.description: The website is fully responsive and automatically adapts to different screen sizes.
